result.identity: Brightside Fixtures - a regional lighting showroom running Google Ads, Meta and Microsoft Ads to a contact form
result.brand_voice: plain-spoken, specific, no hype, no exclamation marks
result.instructions: Report per channel. Name the tool that proved each verdict. A number you could not read is unreadable, never zero.
rules: Money pages are /contact (the form) and /thank-you (where the conversion fires).
Never edit site code, tags, or containers from a diagnosis pass - file the fix as a PM task with the coding brief attached.
Offline conversion uploads stay validate-only until the owner flips them live in the dashboard.
result.memory_notes: Consent banner is CookieYes with Consent Mode v2. Ad platforms connected: Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads. GA4 property 512345678 is connected for organic baselines.

warnings: microsoft_ads: connection conn_bing_1 (Brightside - Microsoft Ads) last synced 2026-08-27T23:00:00Z, 40h ago against the 25h threshold - window numbers and pacing for this platform read low until a sync completes
microsoft_ads: pacing reads low because of the stale sync (the two most recent days are missing from the cache)

channels.headline: 24 form leads arrived from Google Ads clicks in the last 30 days and Google Ads recorded 9 of them.
channels.how_we_know: 24 form-lead rows in the window carry a gclid and a CRM contact. On /thank-you the Google Ads conversion request was observed only in the visitor-who-accepted load; the first-time-visitor load sent nothing to googleads.g.doubleclick.net. The ad account's Contact form lead action last recorded on 2026-08-15.
channels.how_to_fix: Stop rendering the Ads conversion snippet behind the marketing-consent condition on /thank-you and let Consent Mode carry the consent state, then redeploy production. analytics_diagnose_tracking has the file and line.
channels.agent_task: In src/app/thank-you/page.tsx remove the consent.marketing render condition around the gtag conversion event for AW-8123456789/AbCdEfGhIj and rely on the Consent Mode v2 defaults set in layout; redeploy production; confirm with analytics_probe_page that the conversion request appears as a first-time visitor.

how_deeply_we_can_see.note: site probe plus ad-account conversion actions read live

channels.headline: 19 form leads arrived from Meta ad clicks in the last 30 days and Meta recorded 0.
channels.how_we_know: 19 form-lead rows carry an fbclid and a CRM contact. Neither /contact nor /thank-you made a request to connect.facebook.net or facebook.com/tr in either consent state, so no pixel is present in the HTML production serves. The Lead - contact form custom conversion last fired 2026-07-28T01:47:00Z.
channels.how_to_fix: The pixel is in the project source but production has not been deployed since 2026-07-28; deploy production. analytics_diagnose_tracking confirms the source-versus-served gap.
channels.agent_task: Run deploy_site for site_brightside_main to production so the fbq('init','778812345') snippet in src/app/layout.tsx (commit c41e9f2) reaches served HTML; then confirm with analytics_probe_page that facebook.com/tr is requested on /thank-you.

how_deeply_we_can_see.note: site probe plus custom-conversion catalogue read live (readability ok)

channels.headline: 11 form leads arrived from Microsoft Ads clicks in the last 30 days and Microsoft Ads recorded 4.
channels.how_we_know: 11 form-lead rows carry an msclkid and a CRM contact. The UET conversion request to bat.bing.com was observed on /thank-you in both consent states. platform_recorded is read from the connection's sync cache.
channels.how_to_fix: Compare goal conversions against Hiveku over the same window once the platform side is current; the tag itself fired in both consent states.

how_deeply_we_can_see.note: site probe live; ad-account numbers from the local sync cache

channels.headline: 27 form leads arrived from organic search in the last 30 days and GA4 recorded 27.
channels.how_we_know: 27 form-lead rows with an organic search first touch and a CRM contact; GA4's generate_lead key event counts 27 with default channel group Organic Search. The form ledger holds 60 organic rows in the window; 31 sit in the spam bucket (marketing_form_conversion_audit has the split and the rows).

findings.what_is_wrong: The Google Ads conversion snippet on /thank-you is rendered only when marketing consent is already granted. Consent Mode v2 defaults are denied and the CookieYes policy has defaulted marketing storage to denied since 2026-08-15, so a first-time visitor's conversion never leaves the browser.
findings.how_we_know: Source: src/app/thank-you/page.tsx line 41 wraps gtag('event','conversion',{send_to:'AW-8123456789/AbCdEfGhIj'}) in an if (consent.marketing) render condition. Runtime: no request to googleads.g.doubleclick.net as a first-time visitor; one request as a visitor who accepted.
findings.how_to_fix: Render the conversion event unconditionally and let Consent Mode carry the consent state (it degrades to cookieless pings when denied) instead of gating the render on consent; then redeploy production.
findings.agent_task: Edit src/app/thank-you/page.tsx: remove the if (consent.marketing) condition around the gtag conversion call for AW-8123456789/AbCdEfGhIj so the event fires on every /thank-you load. Keep the Consent Mode v2 default block in src/app/layout.tsx untouched. Redeploy production. Verify with analytics_probe_page({ url: 'https://brightside.example/thank-you' }) that the googleads.g.doubleclick.net request appears in as_first_time_visitor.

findings.what_is_wrong: The Meta base pixel (778812345) is present in the project source but absent from the HTML production serves.
findings.how_we_know: Source commit c41e9f2 (2026-08-20T16:05:00Z) adds fbq('init','778812345') to src/app/layout.tsx. Production serves build 9b02a7d, deployed 2026-07-28T02:10:00Z, and neither /contact nor /thank-you made a request to connect.facebook.net or facebook.com/tr in either consent state.
findings.how_to_fix: Deploy production (deploy_site) so the pixel in the source reaches served HTML. The source needs no change.
findings.agent_task: Run deploy_site({ project_id: 'site_brightside_main', environment: 'production' }) after operator confirmation. No code change. Verify with analytics_probe_page({ url: 'https://brightside.example/thank-you' }) that a facebook.com/tr request appears in both consent states.

result.coding_agent_brief: Project site_brightside_main (Next.js, brightside.example). Two conversion-tracking defects. (1) google_ads, critical, consent-changes-outcome: src/app/thank-you/page.tsx line 41 renders the Google Ads conversion event for AW-8123456789/AbCdEfGhIj only inside if (consent.marketing); remove that condition so the event fires on every /thank-you load and let the Consent Mode v2 defaults in src/app/layout.tsx carry consent state. (2) meta_ads, high, tag-not-deployed: commit c41e9f2 already contains fbq('init','778812345') in src/app/layout.tsx but production still serves build 9b02a7d from 2026-07-28; no code change, production needs a deploy. Both fixes ship in one production deploy. Verify afterwards with analytics_probe_page on https://brightside.example/thank-you: expect googleads.g.doubleclick.net in as_first_time_visitor and facebook.com/tr in both consent states.

blindSpots: Resource timing only: request bodies and response status codes are not visible.
A request observed is a request sent, not a request the platform accepted.

warnings: Contact form lead (cact_form_lead): nothing recorded for 14 days (last 2026-08-15T09:22:00Z); 9 in the 30-day window
result.note: Silence is judged on all_conversions. conversions counts only actions in the Conversions column.

caveats: This is Hiveku's record of form fills, not the platform's record of a conversion; view-through conversions have no click and can never appear here.
The platform dates a conversion by the CLICK; these rows are dated by the submission event.
Spam rows still exist as rows - filed, not discarded. Read the rows before quoting the count.

result.summary: Call conversions are reaching Google Ads. 6 qualifying calls in the window, 6 uploaded and accepted, 0 failed, 0 queued.

checks.explanation: Pool pool_bright_1 has 4 active tracking DIDs and no exhaustion events in the window.
All 4 DIDs route to the showroom ring group and carry a validated E911 address.
The DNI loader tag was present in the served HTML of https://brightside.example/contact on the last fetch.
5 of 6 qualifying calls had a pool session carrying a gclid; the sixth was a direct dial with no session, uploaded by caller id match.
Tenant policy uploads calls of 60 seconds or longer; the threshold matches the Google action's phone_call_duration_seconds.

Hiveku - Phone Call (cact_phone_call) is ENABLED with source Upload. It is excluded from the Conversions column by design (include_in_conversions_optimization false), which is why the ad account shows conversions 0 next to all_conversions 6.
6 rows uploaded, 0 failed, 0 queued older than one hour.

Marketing notes for Brightside Fixtures: money pages are /contact (form) and /thank-you (conversion). Consent banner is CookieYes with Consent Mode v2. Ad platforms: Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads. The offline-conversion lane is not opted in.

2026-08-29 tracking check: google_ads partially_tracking (24 Hiveku vs 9 platform; the /thank-you conversion snippet renders only behind marketing consent - consent-changes-outcome, pmt_1); meta_ads not_tracking (19 vs 0; pixel in commit c41e9f2, production still on 9b02a7d from 2026-07-28 - tag-not-deployed, pmt_2); microsoft_ads could not be verified (connection 40h stale, UET fires in both consent states - re-check after a sync); organic tracking (27 = 27; the 31 spam rows are a daily bot, not lost leads). Hiveku - Phone Call reads conversions 0 / all_conversions 6 by design - do not flag it.
